text.autoconfig.bpk.title: BPK Mod
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.general.sprin: If enabled, you could sprint even if you are backward
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.general.inert:
Stops the player from moving when their momentum is deemed negligible
JE 1.8.9: 0.005
BE doesn't have such mechanic, if you want to simulate BE, try 0.0001 or less
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.general.isBES: Clears horizontal motion when sneaking against edges (BE mode)
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.general.ignor: Hitting a wall will not cancel sprint
text.autoconfig.bpk.option.general.oldCo: Resolve collisions in the fixed Y->X->Z order instead of ordering X/Z by speed
